lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's ninety-nine? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 99? Nope!

lines.text: A book's pages are numbered from one. The digits printed are exactly twice the number of pages.
lines.caption: A book's pages are numbered from 1. The digits printed are exactly twice the number of pages.

lines.text: How many pages does the book have?
lines.caption: How many pages does the book have?

lines.text: Pretend every page owes exactly two digits. Pages one to nine pay only one.
lines.caption: Pretend every page owes exactly 2 digits. Pages 1 to 9 pay only 1.

lines.text: So we start nine digits short. Two-digit pages pay exactly two, so the gap stays.
lines.caption: So we start 9 digits short. 2-digit pages pay exactly 2, so the gap stays.

lines.text: Each three-digit page pays one extra. Nine of them close the gap!
lines.caption: Each 3-digit page pays 1 extra. 9 of them close the gap!

lines.text: That's pages one hundred to one hundred eight. So the book has one hundred eight pages!
lines.caption: That's pages 100 to 108. So the book has 108 pages!

lines.text: Did you get one hundred eight? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 108? Tell me below!
